items.risk: Layout publish webhook lacks timestamp/replay protection (#2485) — a captured legitimate publish can be replayed to overwrite a newer layout
items.mitigation: Fix #2485 (add nonce+timestamp+HMAC parity with esignature webhook); track integration test in action-list

items.risk: Mobile LAYOUT_CACHE_KEY is not tenant-scoped and survives logout (#2486) — user A's layout can leak to user B on shared device or org-switch
items.mitigation: Fix #2486 (namespace cache key by tenant_id + purge on logout); add regression test in QA action-list

items.risk: add_evidence dispute sub-resource remains cross-tenant-writable until PR #2490 lands (#2483) — PR #2450 fixed 5 handlers but missed the sub-route
items.mitigation: Land PR #2490 promptly; add subroute-authz regression as part of ongoing IDOR sweep pattern

items.risk: Announcement cross-tenant fan-out guard is tested only via a pure-Rust re-model, not the real SQL (#2484) — the SQL predicate could regress without the test catching it
items.mitigation: Replace pure-Rust model test with sqlx integration test that exercises the actual RLS policy

items.risk: Multiple shipped MVP features (Epic 6, 10A, 10B, 80, 84) lack KPI instrumentation — product/business decisions run blind (dispute funnel, OAuth token usage, listing view, onboarding-tour completion, layout publish)
items.mitigation: Sequence pm-data KPI-definition tasks (7 items just added to action-list); establish minimum-analytics DoD for future stories

items.risk: FaultStatusCount metric (support-data) diverges from owner/portfolio fault KPIs (open decision from 2026-05-28, still unresolved) — dashboards will disagree with each other
items.mitigation: Land single-source-of-truth metric definitions in shared module; deprecate duplicates

items.risk: Webhook handlers across integrations (booking, airbnb, esignature, layout) lack consistent hardening — #2485 shows layout has no replay guard; unknown parity elsewhere
PR #2571 (DELETE-by-file-key) landed with a same-org reference-check gap (#2573) — an active same-org file key can be deleted out from under a live document row
items.mitigation: Land a reference-count guard + integration test before any client wires the endpoint
items.closed_note: resolved by PR #2597 (2026-07-31) — reference-check guard landed

items.mitigation: Wire mint() at the SSO deep-link entry point; add integration test for the happy-path SSO callback
items.closed_note: resolved by PR #2593 (2026-07-31) — mint() wired at deep-link entry

items.risk: Accounting MVP-loop trio (#2555 / #2558 / #2559) has been sitting 2 days with no reviewer engagement — dispatcher stack is starving on reviewer capacity, not implementer capacity
items.mitigation: Explicit reviewer slot for the trio next 24h; document reviewer-slot rotation policy for large-scope feature PRs

items.risk: Dispute KPI endpoint (#2572 → #2575) is quarantined-test-only in main; a shape regression could ship undetected until reporting starts consuming it
items.mitigation: Un-quarantine the KPIs test; add window_start <= window_end validation; add a second test asserting the reporting-consumer contract

items.risk: Voice-webhook endpoints (voice_webhooks.rs) are effectively unauthenticated in production: (a) cross-tenant auth bypass in authenticate_voice_user, (b) HMAC default-secret fallback + non-constant-time compare, (c) Alexa signature never verified (_signature bound-and-ignored). Phase 1.5 static review, high severity on all 3. PR #2604 added unit tests around the broken code — the tests do NOT fix the findings.
items.mitigation: Land a proper security PR closing all 3 findings; require the shared HMAC secret (no default); actually verify Alexa signature; enforce per-caller tenant scoping. Un-quarantine or re-write the PR #2604 tests after the fix.

items.risk: 84-2 signer-page dispatcher retry pool is exhausted (retry_3/2 now the current row). A third failed no-PR attempt would strand the story indefinitely and pop the last MVP frontend partial off the ranker.
items.mitigation: Spawn a dedicated frontend specialist with tight scope: shipped API contract + screen-map first, page component second. Split page-shell vs signing-flow into two smaller tasks if retry-3 fails.

items.risk: Fresh schedule_cadence.rs extraction (PR #2599, 889 lines) has no dedicated regression test in the extraction PR — a subtle behavior drift in reports.rs cron scheduling could regress silently. reports.rs is at 3329 lines and runs_seen=3 (high churn).
items.mitigation: Add a targeted regression test on reports.rs → schedule_cadence.rs round-trip during next backend rotation slot (queued as pm-scrum-master-schedule-cadence-regression-test-2026-07-31).

items.risk: Dispatcher trigger payload reports buffer-low: claimable=6/72. Throughput is now constrained by reviewer capacity (accounting trio 3-day stall) rather than implementer capacity — dispatcher stack starves on unresolved dependencies + non-claimable rows.
items.mitigation: This Phase 1.6 run refills via role next-actions + ranker; Phase 2 backlog refill supplements. Longer-term: reviewer-slot rotation policy for large-scope feature PRs.
